market_question: Ukraine agrees not to join NATO before 2027?
reasoning: Ukraine’s prior willingness to discuss non-NATO status (Istanbul 2022) and rising diplomatic pressure for peace talks make a formal pledge plausible by 2026. The market’s 17% undervalues this likelihood, given Russia’s insistence on neutrality and possible US-led negotiations.
evidence_points: March 2022 Istanbul talks included Ukrainian proposal of non-bloc status.
Russia demands Ukraine abandon NATO aspirations as a condition for peace.
Potential shift in US policy under new administration to push for a negotiated settlement.
sources_consulted: Reuters reporting on Istanbul peace talks
Official statements from Ukrainian and Russian officials
Chatham House analysis of Ukraine's NATO prospects
